observation.command: cat > /tmp/drive_installer.py <<'PY' import urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar, re, sys, json BASE="http://localhost/qisutu/install.pl" cj=http.cookiejar.CookieJar() op=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj), urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler()) def get(url=BASE): r=op.open(url); return r.geturl(), r.read().decode('utf-8','replace') def post(data,url=BASE): body=urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode() r=op.open(url, body); return r.geturl(), r.read().decode('utf-8','replace') def csrf(html): m=re.search(r'name="CSRFToken" value="([0-9a-f]+)"',html); return m.group(1) if m else None def show(url,html): print("URL:",url) m=re.search(r'(.*?)',html); print("TITLE:",m.group(1) if m else '?') errs=re.findall(r'qisutu-install-error[^>]*>(.*?)',html,re.S) if errs: print("ERRORS:",[re.sub('<[^>]+>','',e).strip() for e in errs]) return html url,html=get(); show(url,html) # Step1 Begin t=csrf(html) url,html=post({"Step":"1","Action":"Begin","CSRFToken":t}) show(url,html) # Step2 accept license url,html=get("http://localhost/qisutu/install.pl?Step=2"); t=csrf(html); show(url,html) url,html=post({"Step":"2","Action":"AcceptLicense","CSRFToken":t,"LicenseAccepted":"1"}) show(url,html) PY python3 /tmp/drive_installer.py
